profile.description: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's most capable model, built for the hardest end-to-end work: complex reasoning, agentic coding, computer use, research, and professional document creation. It runs multi-step workflows with less guidance, asks focused questions only when the answer changes the outcome, and shows strong visual judgment on screenshots and documents. Supports a 1M-token context window, native vision, adjustable reasoning effort, and web search.

Message cost is variable, so longer messages are more expensive than shorter messages. 

| Type | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------|------|------|
| Input | $9.09/1M tokens | 300 points/1k tokens |
| Output (text) | $45.45/1M tokens | 1500 points/1k tokens |
| Output | $0.0091/search | 300 points/search |
| Cache discount | 90% discount on [cached chat](https://help.poe.com/hc/en-us/articles/19944206309524-Poe-FAQs#h_01JMDGNARXH8B0MN452N6N7XHP) |  |


Web searches will add input tokens.

Input rate is 2x and output rate is 1.5x when context is >272k tokens.

When new content is written to the cache, it costs 25% more points than the original input and stays stored for 5 minutes before automatically expiring.
